subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 7/7] nfsdctl: add missing break in update_listeners()

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the nfsdctl utility by adding missing break statements to the update_listeners() function. The bug caused v4 listeners that matched on port and address to be re-tested as sockaddr_in6, leading to incorrect behavior. The patch ensures that each case in the switch statement is properly terminated, preventing fallthrough into subsequent cases.
